name: Enter
summary: Enter builds AI software for corporate legal departments, with particular focus on civil and labour litigation. Its May 2026 Series B raised more than $100 million at a $1.2 billion valuation, making it Latin America's first AI unicorn by its own account.
overview: Enter provides an AI operating system for legal departments, covering workflows around civil and labour litigation. The company was founded in Brazil and is expanding an enterprise product designed to support legal teams and their external law firms.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Reported Series B led by Founders Fund.

bull_case: Legal departments have high-cost, repetitive workflows that can benefit from AI with appropriate review and audit controls. Enter's enterprise deployments and stated growth suggest a credible wedge in a large, under-digitised market.
bear_case: Legal AI is competitive and subject to exacting accuracy, data-security and procurement requirements. Enter's reported revenue and client growth are company statements, and scaling from Brazil into new jurisdictions adds execution complexity.

intelligence.description: An AI operating system for corporate legal departments and litigation workflows.
company: Enter develops AI software for in-house legal teams, focused on civil and labour litigation. Its EnterOS product supports legal workflows while keeping legal strategy with the client teams and the law firms that represent them.

In May 2026, the company announced a Series B of more than $100 million at a $1.2 billion valuation, led by Founders Fund. Enter said that its revenue had grown more than tenfold over the prior year and that EnterOS was handling more than 300,000 lawsuits annually; those operating figures are company-reported.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Enter is a leading example of AI adoption in a regulated, high-stakes enterprise workflow outside the U.S. The important proof points are customer retention, accuracy and expansion into new legal systems, not just its unicorn headline.

changed.text: Announced $100M+ Series B led by Founders Fund at a $1.2B valuation.

takeaways: Enter's core market is corporate legal operations, especially litigation-heavy workflows.
The $1.2B valuation was company-disclosed with its May 2026 Series B.
Accuracy, data controls and multi-jurisdiction expansion are the central risks.
